shortDescription: Backend developer on the DEVEX team building supply chain tooling and platform services for Volvo Cars plants globally
details:
Part of the newly formed Developer Experience (DEVEX) team at Volvo Cars Belgium, building shared tooling, platform services, and development standards used across the organization. The team launched without a PM, PO, or Scrum Master — I took initiative to introduce retrospectives and improve team workflow from day one.

Key projects: designed and led development of a Keycloak Integration Tool that lets management configure and monitor authorization across all Volvo plants; built a production microservice bridging Maximo (the master WMS) and S4M vending machines on the factory floor using bidirectional Kafka event streaming. The microservice was architected with hexagonal (ports & adapters) design and became an internal reference for software quality — recognized for its design patterns, test architecture, documentation, and observability.

Responsibilities span backend development, DevOps (pipelines, Kubernetes, Docker), Angular frontend work, and Kafka support across teams.
